heading: Authorization of appropriations
lead: There are authorized to be appropriated to the Center to carry out this subchapter such sums as may be necessary for each fiscal year.

notes.text: Amendments1998—Pub. L. 105–275 reenacted section catchline without change and amended text generally. L. 104–197 substituted “Authorization of appropriations” for “Authorization” in section catchline and amended text generally.
